How much "rust" a player carries from time out

Source: R/returner_adjust.R
returner_rust.Rd

Rust rises with the club matches a player missed and drains as he plays:

  • at each appearance, the club matches his previous club played between his last appearance and this one, with each match he sat on the bench unused counting bench_weight and each he was not in the squad counting 1, m, give s(m) = (m / centre)^k / (1 + (m / centre)^k), an S-curve (0 for no missed matches, 0.5 at centre, close to 1 well past it). Counting club matches, not days, so the summer break adds nothing;

  • rust before the match is max(s(m), rust carried);

  • after the match it drops by minutes / drain_minutes, never below 0.

On as_of, a player still out carries max(s(matches missed so far), rust carried). Minutes count every competition in lineups, one row per (match, player), capped at minutes_cap (the lineups hold a few corrupt values in the tens of thousands). A player who retired or left the covered competitions keeps accruing missed club matches, so filter to the players you are showing before reading any share.

Usage

returner_rust(
  lineups,
  as_of,
  centre = 4,
  k = 6,
  drain_minutes = 1800,
  bench_weight = 0.75,
  minutes_cap = 120
)

Arguments

lineups

data.frame with player_id, team_id, match_id, match_date (Date or ISO string) and minutes_played. Rows on or after as_of are ignored, so the result is as-at.

as_of

Date the rust is wanted for.

centre, k

S-curve centre (club matches missed) and steepness.

drain_minutes

Minutes back after which the rust from one absence is gone.

bench_weight

How much an unused-substitute game counts, against 1 for not in the squad.

minutes_cap

Minutes above this in one match are treated as this.

Value

data.table, one row per player seen before as_of: player_id, rust, and for the absence behind it club_matches_missed, days_out and minutes_since_return (0 while still out; all three NA when rust is 0).
